span.a: Who is First Health and what is our role?

div.style: font-weight: bold; font-size: 22px; color:#2d699e; position: relative; vertical-align: Left;

p.p: First Health understands the importance of accessible health care. That is why we offer comprehensive health care access solutions, including the First Health Primary Network, a national network encompassing approximately 1.67 million providers. We also provide a range of additional health care network products to cater to our members and client s specific needs.
If you are a member seeking a provider, please use our provider directory here.

For our clients, we offer extensive cost containment solutions designed to help you manage and reduce medical care expenses. Learn more about our products, or to contact us, use the Contact us link below.
